hearings.judge: CCH23 XXV ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE
hearings.business_text: Advocate for Dhr filed memo along with copy of the order passed by the Hon\''ble Supreme Court in Appeal No.25339/2023. Perused the said order. On perusal of the same, it appears that the Hon\''ble Supreme Court has granted time to the Jdr to vacate and handover the vacant possession of petition schedule property till March 2024. Jdr is present. Sri. R.V.K advocate filed vakalath for Jdr. Advocate for Jdr filed memo, stating that Jdr is handing over the keys of the suit schedule premises to the decree holder by reserving his right to initiate separate proceedings against the Dhr for recovery of security deposits if any. Memo is placed on record. Counsel for Dhr has received the key of the petition schedule property from the Jdr and made an endorsement for having received the key. Since, the Jdr has handed over the key of the petition schedule property, I feel it is just and proper to close the petitioner as E.F.S, in view of this, I proceed to pass the following:- ORDER Petition is ordered to be closed as E.F.S.

hearings.judge: CCH23 XXV ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE
hearings.business_text: Perused the bailiff report. As per bailiff report petitioner schedule property was kept under lock. As such delivery warrant is not executed. Advocate for Dhr filed IA.No.1 U/s 151 of CPC seeking for an order for issue of delivery warrant by break open the lock of the petition schedule property. Heard and perused the affidavit in support of application. The grounds urged in the affidavit are satisfied to issue delivery warrant by break open the lock. In view of this, and in the interest of justice, I proceed to pass the following:- ORDER IA.No.1 is allowed. Accordingly, issue delivery warrant by break open the lock. R/by 06.04.2024.

hearings.judge: CCH23 XXV ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE
hearings.business_text: Perused the office note. As per office note RFA.No.140/2019 is pending. Perused the record. The Dhr has produced the copy of the order passed by the Hon\''ble High Court of Karnataka in R.F.A.No.140/2019. On perusal of the said order, it is clear that the said R.F.A was disposed of on 11.08.2023 by confirming the judgment and decree passed by this court. Thus, directing the respondent i.e., Jdr herein to vacate and hand over the vacant possession of the schedule premises within 2 months from the date of receipt of copy of the judgment. This execution petition is filed within 2 years from the date of judgment and decree passed by the Hon\''ble High Court of Karnataka in R.F.A.No.140/2019. Hence, issuance of cause notice to the Jdr is hereby dispensed with. Accordingly, issue delivery warrant against the Jdr. R/by 23.02.2024.
